item.title: Weak-Solvation Molecular Ion Gates Enabling Multipath Li + Hopping and Air Stability in Garnet/Poly(ethylene oxide) Electrolytes
item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a weak-solvation molecular ion gate (WSMI) that chemically anchors 4-methoxy-2-(trifluoromethyl)benzoic acid onto LLZTO, removing Li2CO3 and enabling multipath Li+ hopping. It simultaneously boosts air stability, Li+ transference (0.622), and cycling life, offering a new interfacial design principle for garnet/PEO solid-state batteries.
🏷 composite polymer electrolyte · LLZTO · PEO · weak solvation · air stability

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using bromide-complexed anionic Zn–Cu chemistry with a cation exchange membrane, enabling high areal capacity, long cycling, low self-discharge, and Ah-scale scalability. Its significance is exceptional recyclability (~97% Zn, ~100% Cu) via simple, low-cost processes, making AZC batteries promising for sustainable, low-cost, high-performance large-scale energy storage.

💡 Na3P in PVDF electrolytes cleaves C–F bonds, lowering crystallinity and releasing F– to form a NaF-rich interphase. It also acts as a fast-ion conductor, cutting desolvation and F– migration barriers, boosting conductivity to 6.93×10–4 S cm–1. This enables anode-lean solid-state sodium batteries with ultralong cycling stability and practical pouch-cell performance.

💡 This work introduces an electrostatically coupled PAMPS–PB interphase combining high modulus with synergistic anion–cation regulation. Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Fluorinated AlPO4 surface coating on Li-rich layered oxides uniquely combines oxygen-framework stabilization with interfacial charge redistribution, enhancing Li affinity and structural reversibility. This yields 95.9% initial Coulombic efficiency, 244-cycle stability versus 57 for pristine, and reduced voltage decay (0.23 V), offering a multifunctional strategy for high-capacity anionic-redox cathodes.
